comparison.position: RAP在同一双曲空间中压缩维度，保持每点到指定原点的半径，只随机投影并归一化角方向；不拟合数据。
comparison.tradeoff: HVMap学习异构编码器空间的配对映射并联合原生/映射分数；RAP不对齐不同编码器，也不能把不同曲率或原点的向量直接混用。二者解决的不是同一检索瓶颈，现有L1不支持语义检索收益比较。

analysis.title: RAP: Radial-Angular Random Projection for Hyperbolic Representations
analysis.body: HVMap学习异构编码器空间的配对映射并联合原生/映射分数；RAP不对齐不同编码器，也不能把不同曲率或原点的向量直接混用。二者解决的不是同一检索瓶颈，现有L1不支持语义检索收益比较。 对应 Eq11–12。非原点方向若落入投影核则不可归一化，必须拒绝；原点映射为目标原点。同射线距离精确保留；任意角度的距离并非无损。

question.question: RAP能替代HVMap把不同编码器的向量库对齐吗？
question.answer: 不能。RAP压缩同一已定义双曲空间；HVMap从配对表示学习异构空间映射。保持原点半径不提供跨编码器语义对应。
question.example: 教学例：编码器A与B把同一物体置于不同方向，即使两边半径都保持，角向量也不会自动对齐。

update.summary: HVMap学习异构编码器空间的配对映射并联合原生/映射分数；RAP不对齐不同编码器，也不能把不同曲率或原点的向量直接混用。二者解决的不是同一检索瓶颈，现有L1不支持语义检索收益比较。 本轮组件范围闭环；完整矩阵未执行且未认定高成本。

comparison.position: RAP reduces dimension within a hyperbolic geometry, preserving distance to a designated origin and projecting only the normalized angular direction without fitting data.
comparison.tradeoff: HVMap learns paired mappings between heterogeneous encoder spaces and combines native/mapped scores. RAP does not align encoders or permit mixing arbitrary curvatures or origins. Their L1 components do not establish comparative semantic retrieval gains.

analysis.title: RAP: Radial-Angular Random Projection for Hyperbolic Representations
analysis.body: HVMap learns paired mappings between heterogeneous encoder spaces and combines native/mapped scores. RAP does not align encoders or permit mixing arbitrary curvatures or origins. Their L1 components do not establish comparative semantic retrieval gains. These are Eq.11–12. Reject a non-origin direction in the projection kernel; map the origin to the target origin. Same-ray distances are exact, but arbitrary pairwise distances are not lossless.

question.question: Can RAP replace HVMap for cross-encoder alignment?
question.answer: No. RAP compresses one defined hyperbolic space; HVMap learns paired mappings between heterogeneous spaces. Radial preservation provides no semantic correspondence.
question.example: Illustration:if two encoders place an object in different directions, preserving their radii does not align those directions.

english.update: HVMap learns paired mappings between heterogeneous encoder spaces and combines native/mapped scores. RAP does not align encoders or permit mixing arbitrary curvatures or origins. Their L1 components do not establish comparative semantic retrieval gains. The component scope is complete; the full matrix was not run and is not labeled high-cost.

comparison.position: DuoMI按相同token在两轮的全部expert软路由计算两种互信息：聚合使用对齐与逐token变化区间，训练时约束共享expert池的实际复用。
comparison.tradeoff: EchoMoE复用跨层激活参考并压缩通信变化量；DuoMI共享expert参数并约束路由。前者的reference不是后者的expert池，减少通信和改变专家复用不是可交换收益；小张量反传不代表语言模型提升。

analysis.title: DuoMI: Dual Mutual Information Regularization for Expert Reuse in Looped Transformers
analysis.body: EchoMoE复用跨层激活参考并压缩通信变化量；DuoMI共享expert参数并约束路由。前者的reference不是后者的expert池，减少通信和改变专家复用不是可交换收益；小张量反传不代表语言模型提升。 每组8条序列；先逐group、逐pool计算阈值罚项，再平均。默认tau=1、g_max=.02 bits、D区间[.05,.30] bits、三个权重均.1。D是平均JSD，soft D不是Top-k替换比例；只有均匀硬Top-k分布才有D=1−retention。基础语言、负载均衡与z-loss保持原配置。

question.question: DuoMI和EchoMoE里的跨层复用是同一种东西吗？
question.answer: 不是。DuoMI约束共享FFN池的router选择；EchoMoE复用激活reference并压缩差值通信。
question.example: 教学例：同一个expert可被两轮选择，但两轮激活差值仍很大；专家复用率不能替代通信字节测量。

update.summary: EchoMoE复用跨层激活参考并压缩通信变化量；DuoMI共享expert参数并约束路由。前者的reference不是后者的expert池，减少通信和改变专家复用不是可交换收益；小张量反传不代表语言模型提升。 完整矩阵高成本终态，不以L1或审查充当能力证据。

comparison.position: DuoMI regulates realized expert reuse using aggregate alignment and a token-level change band computed from all-expert soft routing at aligned positions in two rounds.
comparison.tradeoff: EchoMoE reuses activation references and compresses communication deltas; DuoMI shares expert parameters and regularizes routing. A reference is not an expert pool. Communication reduction and routing reuse are different benefits, and tensor gradients establish no language-model gain.

analysis.title: DuoMI: Dual Mutual Information Regularization for Expert Reuse in Looped Transformers
analysis.body: EchoMoE reuses activation references and compresses communication deltas; DuoMI shares expert parameters and regularizes routing. A reference is not an expert pool. Communication reduction and routing reuse are different benefits, and tensor gradients establish no language-model gain. Each group has eight sequences. Apply thresholds per group and pool before averaging. Defaults:tau=1,g_max=.02bits,D-band[.05,.30]bits,and weights.1. Soft D is not the Top-k replacement fraction; D=1-retention holds only for uniform hard Top-k distributions. The language, load-balancing and z-loss objectives retain their baseline coefficients.

question.question: Is cross-layer reuse the same in DuoMI and EchoMoE?
question.answer: No. DuoMI regulates shared-FFN routing; EchoMoE reuses activation references and compresses communication deltas.
question.example: Illustration:the same expert may process very different activations in two rounds, so expert retention cannot substitute for communication bytes.

english.update: EchoMoE reuses activation references and compresses communication deltas; DuoMI shares expert parameters and regularizes routing. A reference is not an expert pool. Communication reduction and routing reuse are different benefits, and tensor gradients establish no language-model gain. Complete matrices are terminally cost-deferred; L1 or review is not capability evidence.

comparison.position: JEPA EU沿模拟器状态到像素、encoder、预测特征及post-hoc uncertainty逐层追踪扰动，区分RSSM的GRU时间平均与重建目标实体像素权重。
comparison.tradeoff: 预测—规划评测拆表示误差、预测误差和环境成功；JEPA EU分析不确定性在何层丢失。低一步误差、敏感uncertainty及更好规划是不同证据。观测posterior head可恢复当前帧异常信号，但不能用于没有未来观察的imagined rollout。

analysis.title: Not all world models can doubt: how training objective and architecture shape epistemic uncertainty in JEPA and RSSM world models
analysis.body: 预测—规划评测拆表示误差、预测误差和环境成功；JEPA EU分析不确定性在何层丢失。低一步误差、敏感uncertainty及更好规划是不同证据。观测posterior head可恢复当前帧异常信号，但不能用于没有未来观察的imagined rollout。 Laplace只依赖输入特征：若扰动在前面被消掉，换最后读出也看不见。RSSM GRU把单帧扰动按gate缩放，持续扰动才累积；重建目标按像素贡献优化。posterior需观察帧，不可当作规划时可用的prior特征。

question.question: 比预测—规划评测多得到一个uncertainty指标，能跳过实际规划吗？
question.answer: 不能。误差、不确定性与成功率不同。JEPA EU还需真实CEM评估，并且posterior读出虽可检测当前异常，却依赖不可用于想象未来的观察。
question.example: 教学例：用真实下一帧的posterior把异常检出率提高，并不表示planner在执行前就拥有该信号。

comparison.position: JEPA EU traces simulator-state perturbations through pixels, encoder, predictor features and post-hoc uncertainty, separating recurrent averaging from reconstruction-based entity weighting.
comparison.tradeoff: Prediction-planning evaluation separates representation error, prediction error and execution. JEPA EU asks where uncertainty loses a perturbation. Low error, responsive uncertainty and planning success are different evidence. A posterior head observes the current frame and cannot replace a prior head in imagined rollout.

analysis.title: Not all world models can doubt: how training objective and architecture shape epistemic uncertainty in JEPA and RSSM world models
analysis.body: Prediction-planning evaluation separates representation error, prediction error and execution. JEPA EU asks where uncertainty loses a perturbation. Low error, responsive uncertainty and planning success are different evidence. A posterior head observes the current frame and cannot replace a prior head in imagined rollout. A Laplace readout only sees its feature: a perturbation erased upstream cannot be recovered by changing that readout. The RSSM GRU admits a one-frame change through its gate and accumulates persistent changes; reconstruction allocates signal by pixels. The observation-dependent posterior feature is unavailable during imagination.

question.question: Does adding uncertainty remove the need for real planning evaluation?
question.answer: No. Error,uncertainty and success differ. JEPA EU also evaluates CEM; a posterior readout can detect observed anomalies but requires observations absent in imagined futures.
question.example: Illustration:detecting an anomaly with the actual next-frame posterior does not make that signal available before the action.

english.update: Prediction-planning evaluation separates representation error, prediction error and execution. JEPA EU asks where uncertainty loses a perturbation. Low error, responsive uncertainty and planning success are different evidence. A posterior head observes the current frame and cannot replace a prior head in imagined rollout. Complete matrices are terminally cost-deferred; L1 or review is not capability evidence.
